article.title: 被 y marcadores aspectuales en datos de corpus
article.part: Información y discurso avanzado — 信息與進階篇章
article.chapter: Sintaxis y discurso avanzados C1–C2 — 進階句法與篇章 C1–C2

claims.summary: Xiao, McEnery, and Qian (2006) analyze British English and Mandarin Chinese using written and spoken corpora. For syntactic 被 passives, Table 9 reports 1,300 tokens: -le 213 (16.4%), -zhe 19 (1.5%), -guo 4 (0.3%), resultative verb complements 462 (35.5%), resultative de 48 (3.7%), negation 50 (3.8%), and bare forms 504 (38.8%). Their discussion states that aspect markers and resultative material follow the predicate, after 被; e.g. 被批評了, not *被了批評. These frequencies combine the corpora and are not an estimate for Taiwanese Mandarin alone.

locator.passage: §3.4 ‘Interaction between passives and aspect’, journal pp. 131–133 / PDF pp. 23–25, lines 804–822 and Table 9 lines 958–975; corpus scope at §2, pp. 109–110 / PDF pp. 1–2, lines 43–58.
